_howto: Elections polled by the Texas Civix IVIS ENR adapter (server/src/adapters/txivis.js). electionId comes from {base}/electionConstants (base64 JSON: electionInfo.{year}.GE). timeZone is the zone of Home.LastUpdatedTime. countyAliases maps a source county spelling to the atlas name when matchCounty misses it. Set enabled:false to stop polling.
